subject: Request: Merge EMEA + US training blocks for FluxPay — preflight items
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@fluxpay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Torres <mtorres@fluxpay.com>
Date: 2024-12-04T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request to combine EMEA/US training blocks

Hi Camila —

Quick ask: our payments and integrations team in EMEA and a couple of folks on the US side (Matt + Aisha) have overlapping agendas and it's been hard to consolidate learning. We were wondering whether Redwood can combine the two scheduled training blocks next week into a single 3.5hr session that covers both the Console walkthrough and API enablement.

Key constraints:
- EMEA folks prefer 09:00–12:30 CET (which is early morning PT)
- US folks can do a late-afternoon PT slot (15:30–19:00 PT) but we can be flexible if it helps reduce duplication
- We'd like Marcus (engineering) to get into sandbox credentials and a brief KV/cache discussion — he's asked for 30 minutes at minimum

Are there available facilitators who can shift to a combined slot? If so, can you share a short preflight checklist so our IT team can provision the sandbox and SSO ahead of time?

Thanks — Elena
Elena Park
Head of Integrations, FluxPay
[Attachment: initial-needs.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-12-04T09:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to combine EMEA/US training blocks

Hi Elena — thanks for the note, and totally understand the desire to avoid duplicate sessions. We're able to run a combined session but there are a few logistics to align first.

Options that work for our team (all times PT):
1) 2024-12-11 06:30–10:00 PT (maps to 15:30–19:00 CET) — good for EMEA late afternoon / US evening
2) 2024-12-12 08:00–11:30 PT (maps to 17:00–20:30 CET) — slightly later for EMEA, okay for US
3) Split-day: 2024-12-11 08:00–09:30 PT (console walkthrough) + 2024-12-12 08:30–10:00 PT (API deep-dive) — keeps sessions shorter and reduces single-block fatigue

Marcus — can you confirm whether 30 minutes for KV/cache and sandbox provisioning fits inside option 1 or 2? If not, option 3 is a fallback.

Elena — attaching a short preflight checklist (preflight-checklist.pdf) with the SSO and sandbox items we need. We'll also need a list of attendees (emails) to create RBAC entries.

If you confirm preferred option and attendee list I will send calendar invites and a combined runbook.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: preflight-checklist.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-12-04T10:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to combine EMEA/US training blocks

Quick technical note from my side — happy to lead the KV/cache section and the sandbox handoff. A couple of things to flag so we don't get blocked on the day: 

- Sandbox API quota: current FluxPay sandbox project is limited to 250 concurrent tokens by default. For a combined session with live demos and multi-person testing I'd like to bump that to 1,000 for the day. Please have your infra team raise a ticket or share the sandbox project id.
- Service account/key rotation: if you want us to provision an ephemeral service account, we need the name of the GitHub org (for OIDC) or SAML entity id.
- Demo dataset: if you want the demo to use any production-like data, please attach a small sample (anonymized) and note the schema differences.

I'll attach a short text file with sandbox access steps and the minimal commands we'll run during the demo so your security team can pre-approve.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sandbox-access-instructions.txt (TXT, 3KB)]

From: Elena Park <elena@fluxpay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Torres <mtorres@fluxpay.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@fluxpay.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-12-04T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to combine EMEA/US training blocks

Thanks Camila and Marcus — that all sounds reasonable. We've checked with stakeholders and preferred option is #1 (2024-12-11 06:30–10:00 PT).

Attendee list (for RBAC and calendar invite):
- elena@fluxpay.com
- mtorres@fluxpay.com
- aisha.k@fluxpay.com
- simon.holt@fluxpay.com (integration lead, UK)
- natalie.choi@fluxpay.com (security)

Sandbox project id: fluxpay-dev-sbx-03 — will have infra open a ticket to request quota bump to 1,000 for the day.

Can you also include a short segment (10–15m) on rollout/rollback best practices? Our PMs want to understand how Redwood handles canary sizing and automatic fallback.

Appreciate the checklist and instructions; we'll get our SSO admin to confirm SAML entity id and share by end of day.

—Elena

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-12-04T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to combine EMEA/US training blocks

Great — option 1 confirmed. I've created a calendar invite and provisional runbook; attaching the .ics and the combined runbook link. Agenda includes 30m Console intro, 90m API + hands-on (including the KV/cache deep dive), 15m rollout/rollback best practices, 15m buffer/Q&A.

Action items before 2024-12-11:
- FluxPay infra: raise quota ticket for fluxpay-dev-sbx-03 (target 1,000 concurrent tokens) — Elena
- FluxPay security: share SAML entity id or GitHub org for ephemeral service account — Elena / Natalie
- Camila: will send final attendee list to infra for RBAC provisioning by 2024-12-06
- Marcus: will prepare 10–15m rollout/rollback bullets and sample canary sizes

Attachments: calendar-invite-FluxPay-Combined.ics, combined-runbook.md (link in runbook folder)

I'll follow up with a final runbook Monday the 9th once attendee list and SAML info are in. See you all on the 11th.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: calendar-invite-FluxPay-Combined.ics (ICS, 2KB)]
